imageRegistry.caption: Graphic shows potential activity curves in a Tc-99m MAG3 exam done for the evaluation of hydronephrosis. The red curve represents normal biexponential excretion. Green represents a dilated, but unobstructed, system that clears after the administration of furosemide. Blue represents a system that is partially obstructed as demonstrated by partial response to furosemide. Yellow represents high-grade obstruction. In reality, not all cases fall neatly into 1 of these categories and should be assessed for anatomic variants, such as duplicated systems. Always correlate graph with raw images to corroborate findings and exclude technical error.
